argv: Places come and go with a settle (PI1-PI14, decision 0239)
ops.body: - On a spread row (fix mark-overlap), when one "?" leaves, the marks that stay jump to their new places at once while the leaver still fades where it was (UI review U5): a fading mark can sit over the one that moved beside it. Keep the row's old spread until the leave ends, or ease the stayers' `setOffset` over `MOTION.lift`.

argv: Places come and go with a settle (PI1-PI14, decision 0239)
ops.body: - Native: a "?" holding VoiceOver or TalkBack focus is not kept until the focus leaves it, as the web keeps it (UI review U6): MapLibre RN gives `MarkMarkers` no sign of where the screen reader is. It shrinks out like any other.

- [ ] **Do:** on a walk with Places on, watch a "?" grow in and one shrink out, a plain one and one of a spread row. **Expect:** each grows and shrinks about the point it stands on, its stalk's tip or its leg's dot (`transformOrigin` under the native driver inside a MapLibre RN `Marker`); the leave fades first and shrinks late (two drivers of one value) (Places come and go). (PI3)
